scope: Logical column grant/reference obligations under explicit native checking and complete reachable-authority assumptions. Finite PostgreSQL18.6 observations are separate evidence; no SQL/compiler/kernel refinement, arbitrary side-channel freedom, complete backend profile, concurrency/lifecycle/current-authority custody or general prepared-plan theorem.

queries.scope: Assumes exact native reference resolution and native checking of every referenced column before output; no SQL-parser/optimizer/kernel refinement theorem.
queries.smt:
(declare-sort Role 0)
(declare-sort Column 0)
(declare-fun reachablePrivileged (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun r () Role)
(declare-fun columnSelect (Role Column) Bool)
(declare-fun tableSelect (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun referenced (Column) Bool)
(declare-fun c () Column)
(declare-fun withheld (Column) Bool)
(declare-fun ordinary (Role) Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (forall ((r Role))
             (let ((a!1 (forall ((c Column))
                          (=> (withheld c) (not (columnSelect r c))))))
               (=> (ordinary r)
                   (and (not (tableSelect r)) (not (reachablePrivileged r)) a!1)))))
      (a!2 (forall ((c Column))
             (=> (referenced c)
                 (or (tableSelect r) (columnSelect r c) (reachablePrivileged r))))))
  (and a!1 (ordinary r) (withheld c) (referenced c) a!2)))

queries.scope: Permission checks modeled independently of row cardinality; actual empty/LIMIT0 native controls supply finite correspondence only.
queries.smt:
(declare-sort Role 0)
(declare-sort Column 0)
(declare-fun rowCount () Int)
(declare-fun reachablePrivileged (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun r () Role)
(declare-fun columnSelect (Role Column) Bool)
(declare-fun tableSelect (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun referenced (Column) Bool)
(declare-fun c () Column)
(declare-fun withheld (Column) Bool)
(declare-fun ordinary (Role) Bool)
(assert (let ((a!1 (forall ((r Role))
             (let ((a!1 (forall ((c Column))
                          (=> (withheld c) (not (columnSelect r c))))))
               (=> (ordinary r)
                   (and (not (tableSelect r)) (not (reachablePrivileged r)) a!1)))))
      (a!2 (forall ((c Column))
             (=> (referenced c)
                 (or (tableSelect r) (columnSelect r c) (reachablePrivileged r))))))
  (and a!1 (ordinary r) (withheld c) (referenced c) (= rowCount 0) a!2)))
(model-add rowCount () Int 0)

queries.scope: Concrete grant-route countermodel: absence of a column grant is insufficient if table SELECT exists. Native weakening independently observes disclosure.
queries.smt:
(declare-sort Role 0)
(declare-sort Column 0)
(declare-fun reachablePrivileged (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun r () Role)
(declare-fun columnSelect (Role Column) Bool)
(declare-fun c () Column)
(declare-fun tableSelect (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun withheld (Column) Bool)
(assert (and (tableSelect r)
     (withheld c)
     (not (columnSelect r c))
     (or (tableSelect r) (columnSelect r c) (reachablePrivileged r))))
(model-add r () Role Role!val!0)
(model-add c () Column Column!val!0)
(model-add tableSelect ((x!1 Role)) Bool true)
(model-add columnSelect ((x!1 Role) (x!2 Column)) Bool false)
(model-add withheld ((x!1 Column)) Bool true)
queries.model:
[r = Role!val!0,
 c = Column!val!0,
 tableSelect = [else -> True],
 columnSelect = [else -> False],
 withheld = [else -> True]]

queries.scope: Reachability summarizes only actually inventoried grant/SET/INHERIT/owner-view routes; completeness must be established separately.
queries.smt:
(declare-sort Role 0)
(declare-sort Column 0)
(declare-fun reachablePrivileged (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun r () Role)
(declare-fun columnSelect (Role Column) Bool)
(declare-fun c () Column)
(declare-fun tableSelect (Role) Bool)
(assert (and (not (tableSelect r))
     (not (columnSelect r c))
     (reachablePrivileged r)
     (or (tableSelect r) (columnSelect r c) (reachablePrivileged r))))
(model-add r () Role Role!val!0)
(model-add c () Column Column!val!0)
(model-add tableSelect ((x!1 Role)) Bool false)
(model-add columnSelect ((x!1 Role) (x!2 Column)) Bool false)
(model-add reachablePrivileged ((x!1 Role)) Bool true)
queries.model:
[r = Role!val!0,
 c = Column!val!0,
 tableSelect = [else -> False],
 columnSelect = [else -> False],
 reachablePrivileged = [else -> True]]

queries.scope: Nonvacuity of admitted column projection; no row-membership/private-fact theorem.
queries.smt:
(declare-sort Role 0)
(declare-sort Column 0)
(declare-fun k!0 () Bool)
(declare-fun rowCount () Int)
(declare-fun k!1 () Bool)
(declare-fun reachablePrivileged (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun r () Role)
(declare-fun columnSelect (Role Column) Bool)
(declare-fun c () Column)
(declare-fun tableSelect (Role) Bool)
(declare-fun referenced (Column) Bool)
(declare-fun withheld (Column) Bool)
(assert (and (not (tableSelect r))
     (not (reachablePrivileged r))
     (columnSelect r c)
     (not (withheld c))
     (referenced c)
     (> rowCount 0)
     (or (tableSelect r) (columnSelect r c) (reachablePrivileged r))))
(model-del k!0)
(model-add rowCount () Int (ite k!0 0 (+ 0 1)))
(model-del k!1)
(model-add k!0 () Bool (not k!1))
(model-add k!1 () Bool true)
(model-add r () Role Role!val!0)
(model-add c () Column Column!val!0)
(model-add tableSelect ((x!1 Role)) Bool false)
(model-add reachablePrivileged ((x!1 Role)) Bool false)
(model-add columnSelect ((x!1 Role) (x!2 Column)) Bool true)
(model-add withheld ((x!1 Column)) Bool false)
(model-add referenced ((x!1 Column)) Bool true)
queries.model:
[rowCount = 1,
 r = Role!val!0,
 c = Column!val!0,
 tableSelect = [else -> False],
 reachablePrivileged = [else -> False],
 columnSelect = [else -> True],
 withheld = [else -> False],
 referenced = [else -> True]]

queries.scope: Assumes the native EXECUTE actually rechecks current privileges; same-session revoke/regrant/PID control observes this only for the authored prepared query.
queries.smt:
(declare-fun currentGrant () Bool)
(declare-fun published () Bool)
(declare-fun rechecked () Bool)
(declare-fun priorGrant () Bool)
(assert (and priorGrant
     (not currentGrant)
     rechecked
     published
     (=> (and rechecked published) currentGrant)))
